title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #4

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many verses does Surah Al-Fatiha have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 6
   C. 5
   D. 7

2. Which surah tells us not to worship what the disbelievers worship? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Kafirun
   B. An-Nasr
   C. Al-Fatiha
   D. Al-Ikhlas

3. What is a single verse of the Qur'an called? (1 mark)
   A. A juz
   B. A surah
   C. An ayah
   D. A rak'ah

4. Who took care of the Prophet after his mother died and his grandfather passed on? (1 mark)
   A. Waraqa
   B. His uncle Abu Talib
   C. Ali as a baby
   D. Abu Bakr

5. What is a benefit of saying Bismillah? (1 mark)
   A. It stops hunger forever
   B. It cooks the food
   C. It makes food free
   D. It brings blessing to the food

6. Which greeting should players give at the end of a match? (1 mark)
   A. An insult
   B. Salaam and a handshake
   C. Silence
   D. A shout

7. "Ya Sami', hear my dua." Which name is used? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Malik
   B. As-Sami'
   C. Al-Basir
   D. Ar-Rahim

8. The greeting "As-salamu alaykum" is a prayer for (1 mark)
   A. Peace
   B. Money
   C. Food
   D. Rain

9. What are angels created from? (1 mark)
   A. Water
   B. Light
   C. Fire
   D. Clay

10. Which angel spoke to the Prophet in the cave of Hira? (1 mark)
   A. Israfil
   B. Mikail
   C. Atid
   D. Jibril

11. Which prophet is the ancestor of Yaqub? (1 mark)
   A. Dawud
   B. Ishaq
   C. Harun
   D. Musa

12. Which prophet's story shows a person who refused wrongdoing and feared Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Yusuf
   B. Ilyas
   C. Hud
   D. Nuh

13. Which of these is NOT the correct way to treat a prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Respecting him
   B. Following his good example
   C. Worshipping the prophet
   D. Loving him

14. Which verse says Allah sends down pure water from the sky? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 1:1
   B. Qur'an 25:48
   C. Qur'an 112:1
   D. Qur'an 110:1

15. Which of these breaks wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Eating
   B. Sweating
   C. Talking
   D. Passing wind

16. What should a traveller do if unable to know the Qibla exactly? (1 mark)
   A. Try their best and Allah accepts it
   B. Never pray
   C. Ask no one
   D. Wait a year

17. What does "Allahu Akbar" mean? (1 mark)
   A. All praise belongs to Allah
   B. Glory to Allah
   C. Allah is One
   D. Allah is the Greatest

18. What is tartib? (1 mark)
   A. Praying without wudhu
   B. Praying fast
   C. Making dua
   D. Doing the pillars in order

19. Which is a condition and not a pillar? (1 mark)
   A. Sujud
   B. Fatiha
   C. Taslim
   D. Covering the awrah

20. What does adornment mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fasting
   B. Hiding
   C. Praying
   D. Making oneself look neat and nice

21. Which of these should be avoided? (1 mark)
   A. Clean clothes
   B. Shoes
   C. Boys dressing to look like girls
   D. Neat school uniform

22. Which of these is a mobile phone use that follows Islamic manners? (1 mark)
   A. Calling a relative to greet them
   B. Sharing private photos
   C. Playing during prayer
   D. Sending unkind messages

23. What is integrity in media use? (1 mark)
   A. Copying work
   B. Doing right even when nobody is watching
   C. Hiding
   D. Cheating

24. Which is a life skill related to this topic? (1 mark)
   A. Laziness
   B. Gambling
   C. Wasting money
   D. Avoiding begging without justification

25. What is sadaqah? (1 mark)
   A. A loan
   B. A tax
   C. A game
   D. Charity given to please Allah

26. What did the Prophet say about being fair among children? (1 mark)
   A. Favour the youngest
   B. Fear Allah and be fair
   C. Favour boys
   D. Favour the eldest

27. Which is a way to help parents at home? (1 mark)
   A. Break things
   B. Complain
   C. Sweep and wash dishes
   D. Hide

28. Who is a "mjomba"? (1 mark)
   A. Father's sister
   B. Cousin
   C. Grandmother
   D. Mother's brother

29. What did Khadija do when the Prophet returned frightened? (1 mark)
   A. Ignored him
   B. Left
   C. Comforted and covered him
   D. Blamed him

30. Why is it hard to be among the first to believe? (1 mark)
   A. It was easy
   B. Everyone accepted
   C. Few people believed and many opposed
   D. No one cared

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Describe what happened when Jibril came to the Prophet in the cave. (3 marks)

32. Write the meaning of the dua for entering the house. (3 marks)

33. Give three negative uses of media. (3 marks)

34. Explain why we should behave well even when nobody is watching. (2 marks)

35. Explain the meaning of "The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, while there is good in both." (3 marks)

36. Plan a Muslim school sports day including at least five rules or activities. (5 marks)

37. How can planting a tree be an act of worship? (2 marks)

38. State the dua for parents and its meaning. (2 marks)

39. Explain why the Prophet (S.A.W.) is called Al-Amin and how a child can be trustworthy. (4 marks)

40. Describe how parents should correct children who do wrong. (4 marks)

41. What is an attribute of Allah? Give one example. (2 marks)

42. How can you apply the teaching of Al-Falaq about envy in your daily life? (3 marks)

43. Suggest three ways to keep in touch with relatives who live far away. (3 marks)

44. Explain how not brushing teeth can harm them. (4 marks)

45. Describe what a siwak is and how it is used. (3 marks)

46. Explain how a Grade 4 child can apply the command "Iqra". (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — 7
   Al-Fatiha has seven verses.

2. A — Al-Kafirun
   Al-Kafirun states this firmly and ends "For you your religion, for me mine".

3. C — An ayah
   Ayah (plural ayat) means verse; a chapter is a surah.

4. B — His uncle Abu Talib
   Abu Talib cared for him as a young boy.

5. D — It brings blessing to the food
   We ask Allah to bless it.

6. B — Salaam and a handshake
   Respect and greetings are Islamic manners.

7. B — As-Sami'
   Sami' means All-Hearing.

8. A — Peace
   It means "peace be upon you".

9. B — Light
   The Prophet said angels were created from light.

10. D — Jibril
   Jibril came with the first revelation.

11. B — Ishaq
   Yaqub was the son of Ishaq.

12. A — Yusuf
   Yusuf refused temptation.

13. C — Worshipping the prophet
   We worship Allah alone.

14. B — Qur'an 25:48
   Surah Al-Furqan 25:48.

15. D — Passing wind
   Anything from the front or back passage breaks wudhu.

16. A — Try their best and Allah accepts it
   Allah does not burden beyond ability.

17. D — Allah is the Greatest
   Takbir means Allah is the Greatest.

18. D — Doing the pillars in order
   It means order.

19. D — Covering the awrah
   It is met before the prayer starts.

20. D — Making oneself look neat and nice
   Adornment is beautifying.

21. C — Boys dressing to look like girls
   Islam asks each to dress appropriately.

22. A — Calling a relative to greet them
   Keeping ties is good.

23. B — Doing right even when nobody is watching
   Allah sees everything.

24. D — Avoiding begging without justification
   Self-awareness.

25. D — Charity given to please Allah
   Sadaqah is voluntary charity.

26. B — Fear Allah and be fair
   Fairness among children.

27. C — Sweep and wash dishes
   Helping is a duty.

28. D — Mother's brother
   Mjomba is mother's brother.

29. C — Comforted and covered him
   She reassured him.

30. C — Few people believed and many opposed
   The first believers faced hardship.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jibril told him to read, he said he could not read, Jibril pressed him and repeated three times, then recited the first verses.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the command, 1 mark for reply, 1 mark for three times and recitation.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we depend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three parts.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Watching harmful content, wasting time, spreading rumours, cyberbullying, unsafe contacts.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: Allah is Al-Basir and sees everything, and As-Sami' hears everything.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Allah sees and hears and 1 mark for good behaviour.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Both types have good because of faith. But a strong believer can do more good, so a Muslim should try to be strong in body and faith.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for good in both, 1 mark for strong can do more good, 1 mark for the lesson.

36. (5 marks)
   Answer: Bismillah at the start, modest kits, fair play, warm-up, stop for prayer, respect referees, greet teams, thank Allah at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid rule or activity, up to 5.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: People or animals eat from it, and this counts as charity for the planter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for charity and 1 mark for eating from it.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira: My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for words and 1 mark for meaning.

39. (4 marks)
   Answer: The people of Makkah trusted him with their valuables because he was honest. A child can keep promises, return borrowed items, and keep secrets.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the reason, 2 marks for two ways.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: With wisdom and gentleness, not cruelty. They should explain, listen, forgive small mistakes and set a good example.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: A quality that describes Allah, for example Ar-Rahman, the Most Kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for a correct example.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Seek Allah's protection from envy, be happy when others do well, and do not wish harm on them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for seeking refuge, 1 mark for being happy for others, 1 mark for not wishing harm.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Call, send messages, send gifts, visit in holidays, attend family events.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Food and sugar stay on the teeth, germs turn them into acid, and acid makes cavities which cause toothache and bad breath.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the four steps or harms.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is a small stick from a tree such as the arak. One end is chewed to make fibres, and it is rubbed on the teeth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for stick or tree, 1 mark for chewing the end, 1 mark for rubbing the teeth.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: Read and study daily, ask teachers questions, use safe sources to learn, share knowledge with others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four ways.
